source.name: NBA Communications (pr.nba.com): BAL and Rwanda Development Board multi-year extension
source.quote: Visit Rwanda will continue to be showcased on BAL team uniforms and at the BAL Combine.
source.note: League-wide BAL uniform branding (2023 release). Al Ahly Ly is one of the BAL's 12 clubs in 2026: https://pr.nba.com/basketball-africa-league-2026-season/

source.name: The BAL (bal.nba.com): BAL names PUMA as league's official outfitter ahead of 2026 season
source.quote: PUMA supply all official BAL team, fan and referee apparel, including game uniforms, warm-up gear, practice wear, accessories
source.note: PUMA is the BAL's Official Outfitter from the 2026 season, supplying game uniforms for all BAL teams. BAL match imagery shows PUMA marks on Al Ahly Ly's 2026 jerseys (cdn-bal.nba.com/manage/sites/3/2026/05/maxresdefault-91.jpg); an April 2026 BAL photo of the white jersey shows a Jumpman mark instead (cdn-bal.nba.com/manage/sites/3/2026/04/Jo-Lual-Acuil-42-points-record-celebration-2-1-scaled.jpg), so outfitter branding is mixed early in the season.

summary: League-controlled branding only: PUMA (the BAL's official outfitter from the 2026 season) and Visit Rwanda carry on all BAL uniforms, incl. Al Ahly Ly's. No club-level shirt sponsor found; back, shorts and sleeve placements could not be checked from available imagery.
